description.value:
You learn to shape raw paracausal Notum streams into utilitarian and offensive nanoprograms.

Progression: You follow a full-caster progression (Tiers 1–9).

Wisdom Nanocasting: Wisdom is your nanocasting ability for your meta-physicist programs.

Programs Known: You know 9 nanoprograms of 1st tier at 1st level.

Nanopool Points: You possess a pool of Nanopool points equal to your Meta-Physicist Level × 4 + your Wisdom modifier. Expended Nanopool points are restored when you finish a Long Rest.

High-Tier Limits: Nanoprograms of 6th, 7th, 8th, and 9th tier can each be compiled only once per Long Rest.

Execution Requirement: Executing your nanoprograms requires at least one free hand or an attuned Notum focus stave or device.
